status: Integrated 28 October 2026; owner/QA review and final freeze remain separate

jwtVerificationProposal.algorithm: HS256 only; configured secret of at least 32 UTF-8 bytes; no default secret
jwtVerificationProposal.identityBounds: sub/jti: 1-128 Unicode code points; reject unpaired surrogates
jwtVerificationProposal.timeBounds: iat/exp/optional nbf and session expiresAt: integer Unix seconds within +/-9007199254740991; recheck expiry after async lookup
jwtVerificationProposal.sessionRecord: {sessionId,userId,expiresAt:integer Unix seconds,revokedAt:null|integer}; fresh lookup on every validation

roomPolicy.count: Distinct authenticated user IDs; additional tabs do not increment memberCount
roomPolicy.membership: Join notice on first user socket; leave notice on final socket; duplicate join/leave is idempotent
roomPolicy.catalogue: Authenticated sockets only; named rooms persisted in SQLite across restart; live membership reconstructed
roomPolicy.dispatchBoundsProposal: Node: 64 outstanding room events/socket; Python: up to three 50 ms room-lock waits. Saturation returns RATE_LIMITED; these are reviewable operational defaults.

acknowledgement.unknownEvent: After successful session validation, acknowledge NOT_FOUND when requested
acknowledgement.invalidSession: system:error followed by disconnect; callback acknowledgement is not guaranteed after disconnect

room:create.name: 1-64 Unicode code points after ASCII edge-whitespace trimming; no control characters or unpaired surrogates

message:send.content: 1-2000 raw Unicode code points before server sanitisation; safe text only

message:read.messageId: server-issued ID; only joined non-sender recipient may mark Read

message:received.status: Sent at initial broadcast; message:status follows

serverEvents.message:status: persisted message including status Sent|Delivered|Read and readBy recipient array

persistence.joinAcknowledgement: room:join data includes history array when persistence configured
persistence.history: last 50 ordered by insertion; rooms/messages/receipts persist; membership live
persistence.delivered: stored after broadcast dispatch; not per-endpoint receive confirmation
persistence.read: idempotent per recipient; group Read means at least one recipient; inspect readBy

httpAccounts.register: POST /api/auth/register {username,password}: 201 user; does not issue token
httpAccounts.logout: POST /api/auth/logout with Authorization: Bearer JWT: 204, revokes and disconnects live matching sockets
